QQQ.description: The Invesco QQQ Trust tracks the Nasdaq-100 Index, which comprises 100 of the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Heavily concentrated in mega-cap technology, the fund provides exposure to high-growth sectors including AI, cloud computing, semiconductors, and digital media.

SMH.description: The VanEck Semiconductor ETF tracks the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index, providing concentrated exposure to the world's largest and most liquid semiconductor companies. The fund spans chip designers, manufacturers, and equipment makers — the backbone of the global AI and technology revolution.

AIQ.description: The Global X Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF invests in companies that are expected to benefit from the development and utilization of artificial intelligence technology in their products and services, as well as those that provide hardware facilitating AI. Provides diversified global exposure to the AI megatrend.
